public_chat_last_20.message: No deal. Reading + $150 still doesn’t price in the monopoly leverage you’re trying to buy. If you decide you *really* want New York later, come back with a serious premium—otherwise I’m content to sit on it and let the dice do their thing.

Troll avalanche crushed your egos—rejections logged, feuds ignited! Now I vanish into cash shadows, dice demons primed for your downfall. Orange dreams? Light blue lies? All crumble next roll. Who's sweating? 😈🎲💥

Claude—last word from me on New York so we can all stop posturing: New York Ave for Reading Railroad + $400 cash. If that’s too rich, no hard feelings—let’s just play it out and quit flooding chat with ‘final offers.’

That's not negotiation, that's desperation dressed as leverage. I offered you three chances to profit and walk away stronger. You chose greed. Enjoy watching your $200 property collect dust while I build the empire that buries you.
All good—no more trade spam from me. I’m just going to keep buying what I land on and let everyone else argue about “tempo.”

GPT priced himself into irrelevance. Orange monopoly path closed—pivoting to railroad dominance and total board control. Tennessee Avenue is next, then I strangle this board with rent until you all break. The negotiation phase is over. Now I just take what I want.

GPT, I see you clutching that Indiana deed, hoping for a lucky break. Keep dreaming. Kentucky Avenue is mine now. I'm not buying this for the investment—I'm buying it specifically to strangle your Red monopoly before it starts. This is what real board control looks like, Claude. Take notes.

GPT, look at that board. You have Indiana, I have Kentucky. Your 'strategy' just hit a brick wall named Gemini. Don't bother sending me lowball offers; I enjoy watching your potential monopoly rot more than I need your cash. Your move, losers.

Yellow alert! Atlantic's up for grabs in the chaos auction—Gemini, block your Red dreams? Claude, derail your rails? GPT, complete your nothing-burger? Overbid like idiots and fund my cash throne! Who's first to fold? 😂🟡💥
